column1: # Albania's chart of accounts in the structure of the general accounting plan (PKP) as used under the national standards (SKK, Law 25/2018).
# Source: the chart of the Alpha accounting program ("Plani llogarive Alpha", https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/plani-llogarive-alpha/46788440),
# checked against "Lista e llogarive kontabel" (https://kupdf.net/download/lista-e-llogarive-kontabel_58cc6a16dc0d606529c3469b_pdf). The SKK
# do not publish a chart; this is the common one. Names in Albanian as in the source (obvious typos corrected), English added by Gamma.
# Uncertain points: 68132 repeats 68131's name in the source (read as "for distribution and sales", as 6412/6442/68152 are); 35 (goods) has no
# sub-accounts in the source and is used as an account; 4631/4632, 4661/4662 and 460 have no group above them in the source.
# A row's parent is the longest code that starts its own; an account with accounts under it is a group (never posted to).
